gt_interpolation.scope: Difference between interpolation models on four consecutive qualified GT samples. This is reference sensitivity, not a rigorous GT uncertainty estimate or a replacement accuracy score. No runtime changes.

gate_reference.scope: Two explicitly published physical origins, same frozen frontend and 60 s initial fit. Dataset position lever reference is not independently identified; this sensitivity cannot select the origin or certify 10 cm. No runtime/calibration inputs changed.

scalar_loop_covariance.scope: Scalar marker-distance observability only; no GT orientation or outcome-fitted global alignment. Nominal original timestamps and published marker offsets. Shared query weights cap repeated evidence in calibration; match endpoints may still correlate. Fitted displacement includes sensor, deskew and reference error; this is not a validated full SE(3) covariance.

robust_loop_audit.scope: Observer-only existing Cauchy model (delta 1), frozen final graph. No edges removed or weights changed. Graph-conditioned central subset is a diagnostic, not an unbiased calibration set; all observable edges remain reported.

motion_covariance_ablation.scope: Scalar marker distance only. Common time covariance uses (xi_query - Ad(Z^-1) xi_match), so one shared time shift is not counted as two independent endpoint errors. A fitted value includes reference error and cannot establish physical deskew noise. No runtime weights, measurements or scores changed. Query weights do not make shared match endpoints independent.

transport_pair_frontend_comparison.comparison: Final same binary; same XML except SHM segment capacity; source payload qualification stored separately.

configuration.scope: Opt-in single-host profile; 64 MiB is a validated value for this workload, not a general minimum or total process RAM budget.

live_delivery.scope: No production gate or estimator input changed. Timed run includes observer controls; performance figures are diagnostic only. No UDP packet drops were observed at the sampled instant. Callback phases exclude the logger write itself.

relocalization_search.scope: descriptor CPU is calling-thread CPU; total includes its phases; alignment wall sums can overlap

production_log_analyzer_scope: Live-record parsing and phase timing check only, zero parse errors. Overall analyzer status remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE because this harness records process resources separately as CSV and does not populate every optional core timing field.

reverse_transport_control.changed_configuration: segment_size only: 67108864 -> 524288; same final binary and original depth-1 subscription

limitations: Six real sequences are mapping/loop-closure tests, not real-data localization/extension acceptance.
No universal 10 cm or half-core acceptance; input rates remain native 10/20/30 Hz.
M2DGR nominal clock/position reference remain unqualified for centimeter-level scoring. No outcome-selected time/origin is fed to estimators.
HelmDyn native angular GT contains increments inconsistent with integrated raw gyro; no angular or full SE(3) covariance acceptance.
GT gaps remain unscored; interpolation-model sensitivity is not a proven GT error bound.
No new runtime uncertainty floor adopted: leave-one-sequence-out isotropic/common-time/independent-time models do not transfer reliably.
Repeated runs/acquisitions are operational replications, not independent calibration observations.
Core comparison uses pre-cleanup batch binary; final full ROS tests use the source-equivalent split commit module. Asynchronous snapshots can change at callback boundaries.
Final trajectory includes later corrections; live output is evaluated separately.
CPU/source duration is work demand, not concurrent cores when backlog extends execution.
Old build/test and audit-harness failures are retained, including missing batch arguments in two test fixtures and PCL padding versus declared-field comparisons.

M2DGR frontend outputs differ from the preceding frozen replay near the end despite identical raw input; differences are reported explicitly. New gate repeats show the same difference, not proven random variation. Identical-input algorithm timing uses the separate frozen-cloud core comparison.
The 64 MiB SHM profile is opt-in and loopback-only. It does not establish a memory size suitable for every Humble/RMW/workload.
No installation, remote push or deletion of original data occurred.
